widgets_values: Style: A soft, luminous illustration style built on delicate translucent washes blending seamlessly with clean anime-adjacent linework, gentle bleeding and diffusion at the edges lending each plane a tender, organic softness, restrained tonal layering achieved through patient, unhurried wash-building rather than opaque coverage, a hushed, dreamlike stillness carried through soft directional light, and a poetic, wistful character-illustration finish that feels equally hand-painted and anime-refined. Influenced by: traditional watercolor-and-wash technique, contemporary anime-illustration tradition, gentle wash-blending practice, semi-realistic character-art method..【构图运镜】Long shot, low-angle looking up, 24mm wide angle, the balcony on the upper-left and the street below on the lower-right; handheld slight sway.【主体】（苏晚：是一位年轻女子，黑色长发凌乱披散，中国人，桃花眼，深棕色瞳仁，精致鹅蛋脸，鼻梁秀挺，唇色苍白，肌肤苍白，身材消瘦。赤脚，穿着白色棉质睡裙，裙摆被夜风掀起。，女）Su Wan, female;（主角：是一位年轻男子，黑色短发凌乱，中国人，剑眉星目，黑色瞳仁，高挺鼻梁，薄唇，轮廓分明的明星脸，身材高大挺拔。穿着沾了酒渍的深灰色大衣，内搭黑色高领毛衣，深色长裤沾着灰尘，皮鞋鞋面有泥，衣领微皱，满是风霜。，男）Zhou Xiansheng, male.【动作/状态】（苏晚：是一位年轻女子，黑色长发凌乱披散，中国人，桃花眼，深棕色瞳仁，精致鹅蛋脸，鼻梁秀挺，唇色苍白，肌肤苍白，身材消瘦。赤脚，穿着白色棉质睡裙，裙摆被夜风掀起。）Su Wan climbs over the balcony railing, white nightdress whipped by the night wind, torso tipping forward;（主角：是一位年轻男子，黑色短发凌乱，中国人，剑眉星目，黑色瞳仁，高挺鼻梁，薄唇，轮廓分明的明星脸，身材高大挺拔。穿着沾了酒渍的深灰色大衣，内搭黑色高领毛衣，深色长裤沾着灰尘，皮鞋鞋面有泥，衣领微皱，满是风霜。）Zhou Xiansheng sprints from the street below, one arm stretched upward, knees bent, an empty bottle rolling away from his foot.【场景】Exterior of 城市居民楼的阳台，护栏漆皮剥落，角落堆着空花盆，楼下是昏暗小巷与零星路灯，夜风穿过，带着凉意。 and the street below: peeling railing, stacked empty flowerpots, dim alley, scattered streetlights, wet pavement.【物品】Balcony railing, empty flowerpots, empty bottle.【光影氛围】Cold blue-grey night, desaturated memory tone, distant weak streetlights, bleak and hopeless.【时间】Late night.
